text: The **2021 tree-cover loss** was detected by the **University of Maryland’s Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13)**. This dataset observed a **loss area of 81.3 ha** in 2021, meeting the minimum event threshold of 0.5 ha. The European Commission’s JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) corroborated 98% of this area as forest in 2020. The Uruguay Ministry of Livestock’s national forest map (MGAP 2021) further identified the affected area as **planted forest (68.1 ha of Pinus species)**, confirming the loss. The analysis used these datasets under a rule requiring later-year observations and ≥50% agreement with the JRC reference.
